tools.name: service_info
tools.description: Learn the whole workflow and available service capabilities before creating work.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create a private, expiring workspace. Save its capability only in the user's AI conversation.

tools.name: close_workspace
tools.description: Revoke this workspace and its result access. Does not cancel already submitted backend jobs.

tools.name: start_scan
tools.description: Start a REAL public GitHub scan. User authorization required. Reuse request_id on identical retries.

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Poll every >=10 seconds; on done return actual commit, coverage and up to 50 LLM-input findings.

tools.name: start_analysis
tools.description: Start GPU Red/Blue review of one real scan finding. Same inputs deduplicate.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Poll GPU status and delivery gates; inference can take several minutes. Never fake ready results.

tools.name: get_fix_prompt
tools.description: Get a gated real LLM proposal. Agent must inspect code, check repo/commit, fix and test in its workspace.

tools.name: rescan
tools.description: Rescan the SAME repository default branch. Only published changes are visible; unpushed edits are not.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate the service's report from owned server scan and available analyses, indicating incomplete work.

tools.name: incident_report

tools.name: audit_status
tools.description: Scan summary, analysis statuses and which fix prompts (get_fix_prompt) are ready, in one call.

tools.name: check_fix
tools.description:
After fixes are PUSHED to the default branch: rescan the same repo against scan_id and list resolved,
        persisting, new and key-reissue-needed findings. Same commit means the fix was not pushed yet.

findings.detail: Description of "start_scan" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
